name: sap-sandbox
description: SAP Business Accelerator Hub sandbox (read only): real S/4HANA OData APIs (business partners, sales orders, purchase orders, billing, products, journal entries) with SAP sample data. Needs your personal API key from api.sap.com. The sandbox data is fixed and cannot be changed.

tools.name: sap_sandbox_check_connection
tools.description: Check the SAP API key against the S/4HANA sandbox with one small request.

tools.name: sap_sandbox_list_apis
tools.description: List the suggested S/4HANA APIs and their main entity sets (local list).

tools.name: sap_sandbox_list_entity_sets
tools.description: List the entity sets of one S/4HANA API in the sandbox. Read only.

tools.name: sap_sandbox_query
tools.description: Read rows of an entity set with OData options (filter, select, orderby, expand, top, skip, count). Read only.

tools.name: sap_sandbox_get
tools.description: Read one entity by key, for example one sales order. Read only.

tools.name: sap_sandbox_o2c_scan
tools.description: Order-to-cash overview of the latest sales orders and which ones need attention. Read only.

tools.name: sap_sandbox_order_to_cash
tools.description: Trace one sales order through delivery, goods issue and invoice and show where it is stuck. Read only.

tools.name: sap_sandbox_customer_360
tools.description: One customer from partner, orders and invoices with totals and orders needing attention. Read only.

sap_api_key.title: SAP API key
sap_api_key.description: api.sap.com: log in, open your profile (top right), Show API Key, copy it. Stored as a secret. The key is only sent to sandbox.api.sap.com.
